entry.description: Algorithmic Prism reverb from Live's Hybrid Reverb device.

attributes.name: crossover
attributes.digest: Crossover Frequency
attributes.description: Controls the crossover frequency between the low-frequency and high-frequency portions of the reverb tail which in turn adjusts the frequency content affected by the lowmult and highmult attributes. [400., 5500.]

attributes.name: decay
attributes.digest: Decay
attributes.description: Adjusts the approximate time in seconds required for the algorithm's reverb tail to drop to 1/1000th (-60dB) of its initial amplitude. [0.1, 60.]

attributes.name: freeze
attributes.digest: Freeze reverb tail
attributes.description: Sets the algorithm's decay time to infinity so that reverberation will sustain endlessly. Freezing begins when this attribute is enabled and ends when disabled, so you will most likely want to toggle this attribute while audio is being processed for it to take effect.

attributes.name: freezein
attributes.digest: Add incoming signal to the frozen reverb tail
attributes.description: When enabled, new input signals are added to the frozen reverberation. When disabled,will endlessly sustain the output of the reverb, and any additional input signals will not be processed untilis turned off and then back on. This attribute is disabled by default.

attributes.description: Scales the decay time of the high-end of the reverb tail. [0.1, 5.]
